payload.title: DIP-L09: Add explicit capture privacy controls and redaction audit fixtures
payload.description:
Privacy boundary. QA baseline: DIP v0.3.2, 6 October 2026.

Captured prompts and activity can become committed project data. Redaction is heuristic and does not guarantee removal of every secret/private detail; temporary native trace files can contain raw arguments. The README requires user review before publishing.

Evidence and starting points: README.md, docs/git-discovery.md, docs/operations.md.

This is unassigned contributor backlog, not implemented work. Preserve the existing license, DCO and local/offline defaults.
acceptance: Define documented per-project capture/minimization controls and validate configuration without disabling explicit intent persistence silently.
Audit known secret/PII fixtures across prompt, plan, intent and diagnostic paths; distinguish sanitized data from raw temporary trace files.
Expose intentional capture disablement distinctly from unobserved/broken hooks and document retention/review behavior.
Use deterministic local controls with no implicit telemetry, cloud upload or extra model call; keep warranty/responsibility language accurate.
